# GodotLogger Source Generator

Eliminates the `private static readonly ILogger Logger = GodotLog.CreateLogger<T>();` boilerplate.
Annotate any `partial` class with `[GodotLogger]` and the field is injected at compile time:

```csharp
using Godot;
using GodotLogger;

namespace MyGame;

[GodotLogger]
public partial class GameManager : Node
{
    public override void _Ready()
    {
        Logger.LogInformation("GameManager ready!");
    }
}
```

Generated output (zero runtime overhead):

```csharp
// <auto-generated/>
partial class GameManager
{
    private static readonly ILogger<GameManager> Logger =
        GodotLog.CreateLogger<GameManager>();
}
```

The field is always `private static readonly`. Each class gets its own strongly-typed `ILogger<T>`,
so log output automatically carries the correct category name — no manual wiring needed.

---

## Options

| Property    | Type     | Default    | Description                 |
|-------------|----------|------------|-----------------------------|
| `FieldName` | `string` | `"Logger"` | Name of the generated field |

```csharp
// Custom field name — useful when 'Logger' would conflict with an existing member
[GodotLogger(FieldName = "GdLog")]
public partial class PlayerController : Node
{
    public override void _Ready()
    {
        GdLog.LogInformation("GameManager ready!");
    }
}
```
